rules.title: Auth flow changed
rules.message: Authentication changes can affect login, reset, onboarding, and permissions.
rules.suggestedAction: Add or update regression tests for the changed auth flow.

rules.title: Payment or billing code changed
rules.message: Payment code has high user and business risk.
rules.suggestedAction: Check edge cases, rollback behavior, and relevant tests before landing.

rules.title: Migration changed
rules.message: Schema and migration changes can affect persisted data.
rules.suggestedAction: Confirm rollback notes and data compatibility.

rules.title: Config or deployment changed
rules.message: Config and deployment changes can affect runtime behavior outside local tests.
rules.suggestedAction: Check environment-specific impact and deployment safety.

rules.title: Shared utility changed
rules.message: Shared code may have callers outside the visible task.
rules.suggestedAction: Search callers and run the closest related tests.
